text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки dazzles everyone with her
performance
on the track. In the press
conference afterward,
she declares her
intention to become a Triple
Crown
Champion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Everyone is sent into an excited flurry by
her
words. All are watching her
expectantly as she
heads toward the
Asahi Hai F.S.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
